name: FinCom Books v1.2.2

Company creation: type dates like 1-4-2026; the year end and books-from date fill in automatically
New FinCom look and Home screen
Balance Sheet shows true figures instead of a balancing plug
Official GSTR-1 (B2B, B2CL, B2CS, HSN) and GSTR-3B with 1-click JSON export for GST Portal

Credit Control & Period Locking (Debtor credit limits, overdue checks, and period lock)
Cost Centres & Cost Categories allocation tracking in vouchers
Manufacturing & Bill of Materials (BOM) multi-godown component tracking
Company PIN Lock & Master Password for data privacy
